notes.title: Update 1.1.5 - New Game Mode Added!
notes.content: A new Game Mode has been added. Race Mode is a battle to get to the exit as fast as you can against the AI.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1.1 includes the following changes...

[list]
[*]Slingshot Mode - use the mouse to aim your way to the exit. You drag the mouse and release to aim and fire.
[*]Pause menu bug fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Endless Heck Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 of Endless Heck now includes a new game mode called 'Countdown'. The aim of the Countdown mode is to get to the exit before the 10 second timer hits 0.

This update also changes the main menu UI and makes it easier to navigate.

Good luck, don't hit the walls!
